7.2.4.11.12 Rte_Rips_NotifyTpRxIndication
[SWS_Rte_05334] ⌈
Service Name
Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTpRxIndication_<CGI>
Syntax
void Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTpRxIndication_<CGI> (
Std_ReturnType result
)
Service ID [hex]
0xTBD
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non reentrant for same sn, otherwise Reentrant
Parameters (in)
result
Result of the reception.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
Rte_Rips_NotifyTpRxIndication will be called to notify the RTE Implementation Plug-In when an
I-PDU is received via the TP for the LdCom signal used for the Data Communication Graph
requiring transformation, with the result indicating whether the transmission was successful or
not. This function is designed to be a plug-in proxy for the LdCom TP Rte_
LdComCbkTpRxIndication callback. See requirement [SWS_LDCOM_00031] for more details
on the functionality of this callback.
Available via
Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>.h
⌋
[SWS_Rte_05335]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00300, SRS_Rte_00301, SRS_Rte_00312, SRS_Rte_00317
⌈The associated Local Software Cluster Communication Plug-In shall
provide the Rte_Rips_NotifyTpRxIndication Service for each
• dataElement instance in an AbstractRequiredPortPrototype of an
Atomic Software Component
• operation instance in a PortPrototype of an Atomic Software Compo-
nent
• trigger instance in an AbstractRequiredPortPrototype of an Atomic
Software Component
IF
• for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In
support is
